flow_map.rule: Net 20-session ETF creations minus redemptions, from trusted share counts only (integrity test passed and at least 80% of sessions measured). A bucket counts as in or out when its net flow is at least 0.25% of its measured assets. Stocks = US + international equity; safety = Treasuries + cash-like; a class with under 50% of its funds measured is shown but left out of the verdict. A reading within 1 typical day of the ±0.25% line is borderline (a typical day = one standard deviation of the reading's daily change over the last 20 sessions, each recomputed as of that day). ETF data shows where money left and where it arrived, not which dollar went where.

trend.rule: Share of the 109-name constituent proxy closing above its 50-day average, each session from closes up to that session. A change of 10 points or more over 20 sessions (about 11 names) is a trend; a falling trend under a rising SPY is narrowing. Proxy, not the full S&P 500.

top10.verdict: Driven by the top 10: over 20 days SPY -1.16%, of which the top 10 (38.4% of the index) supplied -1.86 points (160% of the move, 4.2x their weight); the other names returned +1.13% — the rest of the index moved the OTHER way
top10.rule: Weights: State Street's daily SPY holdings file. Start-of-window weights are backed out for a buy-and-hold window (w0 = w_now x (1+R_SPY)/(1+r)); contribution = w0 x r. The top 10 carry the move when their share of SPY's 20-day return is at least 1.5x their weight; they lag when it is 0.67x or less. SPY moves under 0.5% are not split.
top10.changes_if: The top 10's share of the 20-day move crossing 1.5x or 0.67x their weight.
